title: Mega menu
lead: Use the mega menu component as a full-width dropdown inside the navbar to show a list of menu items based on multiple sizes, variants, and styles.

prose.text:
The mega menu component is a full-width dropdown that can be triggered by clicking on the menu item and it shows a list of links that you can use to navigate through the pages on a website.

To start using the mega menu component you need to import it from `flowbite-react`:

prose.title: Default mega menu
prose.text: Use this example to show a list of links aligned on three columns inside the mega menu dropdown.

prose.title: Mega menu with icons
prose.text: This example of a mega menu dropdown can be used to also show an icon near the text of the link.

prose.title: Full width dropdown
prose.text: Use this example to show a mega menu dropdown that spans the entire width of the document page.

prose.title: Full width with CTA
prose.text: This example can be used to also show a CTA button or link next to the menu items inside the dropdown.

prose.title: Full width with image
prose.text: This example can be used to also show a CTA with a background image inside the dropdown next to the other menu items and links.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text:
Note:

- `<MegaMenu>`'s theme has all of the same options as [`<Navbar>`](https://flowbite-react.com/docs/components/navbar)'s, with slightly different defaults
- `<MegaMenuDropdown toggle={..} />`'s theme, `megaMenu.dropdown.toggle`, is identical to [`<Dropdown>`](https://flowbite-react.com/docs/components/dropdown), with slightly different defaults

api.reason: 공식 문서에 표 원천이 없어서 **설치된 패키지의 타입 선언(.d.ts)** 에서 뽑았어요 (ADR-025). 그 컴포넌트가 상속받는 프롭까지 따라갑니다. 설명·기본값은 선언에 달린 JSDoc 이라 공식 산문과 문구가 다를 수 있고, `@default` 태그가 없는 프롭은 기본값 칸이 비어요 — 없는 게 아니라 타입이 안 적은 거예요. 타입이 선언하지 않는 것(문서에만 있는 프롭·런타임으로만 받는 값)은 여기 없어요.
